name: Kyoto University
summary: National university in Kyoto, founded 1897; its iUP takes you with no Japanese into a 4.5-year bachelor's that ends mainly in Japanese.

ib.text: Applicants need an IB Diploma awarded by 30 September 2027; predicted grades are accepted and finals requested later. TOEFL iBT or IELTS Academic, or a school English evaluation; no minimum score is set.

dates.label: Shortlisted applicants' original documents due by registered mail

programmes.name: International Undergraduate Program (iUP)
programmes.credential: Bachelor's degree in your chosen major
programmes.about: A six-month preparatory course in intensive Japanese, then a four-year bachelor's in one of nine faculties, such as Science, Engineering or Economics. The first two years can be in English or Japanese; the last two are mainly in Japanese.
programmes.ib: Not all-English: the final two years are taught mainly or exclusively in Japanese, and a Qualifying Test follows the preparatory course.
programmes.selectionNote: Document review, then an online interview in English. You may name up to three faculties; Kyoto assigns one. 40 places for October 2027.

notes: You enrol in the preparatory course in October 2027; the faculty degree course itself starts in April 2028 after the Qualifying Test.

Kyoto states that scholarships with full admission-fee waivers and full or partial tuition waivers for four and a half years are available for all iUP students, plus up to ¥120,000 a month during the preparatory course.
iUP students get a room in a Kyoto University International House for their first 12 months.
